title: SHOWER MEDITATION
target_flaw: Nóng giận, thiếu kiên nhẫn, căng thẳng
content: Bring mindfulness into your routine. Allow your shower to become a meditation. ♦ Take a few deep breaths and experience the temperature of the water. ♦ Really notice the fragrance of the soap. ♦ Mindfully clean every part of the body. ♦ Experience it all as if for the first time.

title: TABULA RASA
target_flaw: Dính mắc quá khứ, bám víu thói quen cũ
content: Today is full of new possibility. Meditate for at least five minutes silently repeating the mantra "Tabula Rasa," which means "blank slate." When the mind wanders, come back to the mantra. With each exhale, allow a wave of relaxation to pass through the body, as if it's wiping the slate clean. Let go of old habits, old ways of doing things, and even old challenges.

title: MIND AND MOUTH
target_flaw: Sống vội vã, vô thức, mất kết nối cơ thể
content: Bring mindfulness into your dental hygiene in this toothbrushing meditation. 1. Begin by noticing the taste inside your mouth. 2. Run your tongue along the surface of your teeth: the front, back, and biting surfaces of both the top and bottom rows of teeth. 3. Do this slowly and feel every single tooth with your tongue. 4. Now begin to brush. Do so slowly and become very conscious of the way you are brushing. 5. Close your eyes and envision the bristles as you feel them along your teeth and gums. 6. Brush your tongue, the roof of your mouth, your gums, and even the inside of your cheeks. Do this slowly and meditatively, being very present with the experience. 7. Bring consciousness into your rinse as well. Notice the experience and take your time.

title: AFFIRMATION FOR RESILIENCE
target_flaw: Sợ hãi sự thay đổi, yếu đuối tinh thần
content: Repeat this affirmation throughout the day, especially when facing challenges: "The only constant is change — I am naturally very resilient." Say it silently or aloud whenever you feel resistance or fear arising. Trust that you have overcome challenges before and will again.

title: THERMAL EXERCISE IN THE SHOWER
target_flaw: Dính mắc vùng an toàn, trì trệ, trầm cảm nhẹ
content: Exposing your body to temperatures outside the normal comfort zone is a great way to practice non-attachment and has incredible health benefits. 1. Take a shower and finish cleaning your body in your normal routine. 2. Increase the temperature slightly above what you would normally find comfortable. 3. Take a few deep breaths in the hot water, allowing the body to relax. 4. Then decrease the temperature slightly below what you would normally consider comfortable. 5. Take a few deep breaths in the cold water, allowing the body to relax once more before you finish your shower.

title: THERE IS SO MUCH MORE
target_flaw: Thờ ơ, vô cảm, thiếu trân trọng cuộc sống
content: Throughout your day, open your awareness to all that surrounds you. We take so many things for granted. As you observe the world today, silently repeat the following mantra: "There is so much more to know about that ______." Name specific things you see, whether it be a chair, a person, a cloud, a tree, and so on. Approach life with the eyes of a child discovering things for the first time.

title: AHHH... THANK YOU. YES!
target_flaw: Hay than vãn, thiếu lòng biết ơn, bất mãn
content: This meditation will help you embody and experience a genuine sense of happiness and gratitude. 1. Get into a comfortable position and set a timer for at least five minutes. 2. Open your mind to being genuinely grateful, not for anything in particular. 3. Close your eyes and bring your awareness to your breath. 4. On your exhales, silently repeat the mantra: "Ahhh... Thank you. Yes!" 5. When your timer goes off, sigh out the mantra out loud three times.

title: ACCOUNTABILITY AND RESPONSIBILITY
target_flaw: Đổ lỗi cho người khác, tránh né trách nhiệm, ngã mạn
content: Taking responsibility for our character defects communicates to our unconscious minds that things need to change from the inside out. Reflect on a personal situation that feels uncomfortable or unresolved for you. 1. Write an objective description of what happened and try to be as fair as possible when describing it. No one will read this but you. 2. In what ways did you contribute to the rift or negativity of the situation? 3. What could you have done differently? 4. What will you do next time something similar takes place?

title: SELF-COMPASSION BODY SCAN
target_flaw: Tự ti, ghét bỏ bản thân, khắt khe với bản thân
content: Loving-kindness meditations are a powerful way to cultivate compassion, receive it for ourselves, and direct it to others. Today, practice a loving-kindness body scan meditation, directing love, acceptance, and compassion to every part of your body. ♦ Lie down comfortably on your back, in loose-fitting clothing. ♦ Close your eyes and bring your awareness to the breath. ♦ Mentally scan every part of your body, beginning with your head and moving all the way down to your feet. ♦ Visualize a warm glow of light filling each body part as you silently say, "Thank you. I love you. You are perfect."

title: MIND INVENTORY
target_flaw: Tản mạn tư tưởng, lo âu, suy nghĩ hỗn loạn
content: In a journal or on a blank sheet of paper, write out a full page of whatever thoughts are coming to mind. Don't hold back. List everything you're thinking about, big and small, taking a full inventory of all that crosses your mind. Don't judge or edit — simply empty your mind onto the page. This clears mental clutter and creates space for clarity and peace.

title: THE LITTLE THINGS
target_flaw: Coi thường điều nhỏ nhặt, thiếu trân trọng hiện tại
content: Contemplate something small in your life that you're grateful for. Take a few breaths and really experience a sense of deep, sincere appreciation for it, no matter how small or insignificant it may seem. It could be the warmth of sunlight on your skin, the softness of a pillow, or the sweetness of a fruit. Allow gratitude to expand from this small thing outward to all of life.

title: INTENTION SETTING
target_flaw: Vô định, thiếu mục tiêu, lạc hướng trong cuộc sống
content: Set a meaningful intention for yourself in meditation today. As we "in-tend," we are "invoking tendencies," meaning that we are calling forth new qualities of being from within ourselves. Ask yourself: ♦ What do I want to achieve? ♦ What are some qualities that others who have successfully achieved this possess? ♦ What are the thoughts that may occur in the mind of one who achieves this? Sit with these questions and let the answers arise naturally.

title: VAJRASATTVA PURIFICATION — MORNING WASH
target_flaw: Nóng giận, sân hận, tội lỗi, nghiệp chướng tích lũy
content: Khi rửa mặt hoặc tắm buổi sáng, quán tưởng nước không phải là nước thường mà là dòng Cam Lồ (Amrita) trắng ngần từ thân Kim Cang Tát Đỏa (Vajrasattva) tuôn chảy xuống từ đỉnh đầu. Mỗi giọt nước tiếp xúc với thân tịnh hóa nghiệp chướng — đặc biệt là nghiệp Sân hận tích lũy từ hôm trước. Trong khi rửa mặt, trì thầm 21 biến Chú Bách Tự Minh ngắn: Om Vajrasattva Hum. Hình dung luồng ánh sáng trắng thấm vào từng tế bào, tẩy sạch tất cả dấu tích tiêu cực. Kết thúc bằng lời phát nguyện: Nguyện công đức này hồi hướng cho tất cả chúng sinh.

title: JAMBHALA OFFERING — BEFORE EATING
target_flaw: Xan tham, keo kiệt, thiếu lòng bố thí, tài lộc hao mòn
content: Trước khi đưa miếng ăn đầu tiên vào miệng, dừng lại 10 giây và thực hành cúng dường bằng tâm. Quán tưởng bàn ăn của bạn trở thành bàn cúng đồ sộ với vô số loại thực phẩm. Phía trên đỉnh đầu bạn xuất hiện Hoàng Thần Tài Jambhala — màu vàng sáng rực, cầm Mongoose phun ngọc châu. Dâng toàn bộ thực phẩm lên Ngài và tất cả Phật, Bồ tát trong Ngũ Phương. Trì thầm: Om Jambhala Jalendraya Svaha (3 lần). Quán tưởng ánh sáng vàng từ Jambhala tan vào thức ăn, rồi thức ăn này nuôi dưỡng thân bạn để tiếp tục tu tập và giúp ích chúng sinh. Hành động nhỏ này mỗi ngày tích lũy phước lành tăng ích tài lộc.

title: GURU YOGA — WAKING UP
target_flaw: Lười biếng, thiếu tinh tấn, quên mục đích tu tập
content: Khoảnh khắc vừa thức dậy, trước khi mở điện thoại hay đứng dậy, nằm yên nhắm mắt 60 giây. Quán tưởng phía trên đỉnh đầu bạn xuất hiện Gốc Sư (Đạo sư Truyền thừa Yangti Nakpo) trong thân Liên Hoa Sinh hoặc bất kỳ bổn sư nào của bạn — tỏa sáng như mặt trời. Nhất tâm phát đại nguyện: "Con xin quy y Tam Bảo và Đạo Sư. Ngày hôm nay, mỗi hành động, lời nói và suy nghĩ của con đều là cúng dường. Nguyện con tu tập tinh tấn vì lợi ích chúng sinh." Trì Thất Cú Kệ Liên Hoa Sinh 3 lần: Ho Guru Pema Siddhi Hum. Cảm nhận ánh sáng từ Đạo Sư tan vào thân tâm bạn.
